title: TECNALCO FlowBar - High Throw (HT) series, continuous slot plenum
source: Flowbar catalogue.pdf - performance data p.6 (TFB-10/15/20/25/30-HT), correction tables A and B
notes: Cells are transcribed verbatim: [Static pressure (Pa), 'min-mid-max throw (m)', 'NC']. Throw values are for terminal velocities 0.8 / 0.5 / 0.3 m/s.
Data is based on a 1200 mm active section (reference_length_m = 1.2); table B gives throw multipliers for other lengths, table A gives NC corrections (supply).
Rows are slot width in mm. The catalogue has 25/38/51/63/76 mm; the spec's dropdown value 20 mm has no catalogue data and returns 'no valid selection'.
Each row has its own L/s/m columns (they differ per slot width).
No Ak is published; the row 'ak' is the slot face area per metre (slot width in m x 1 m) so a face-velocity limit can still be applied. TODO(open): confirm.

TODO(open): 'No. of Slots' is not a catalogue dimension. With parameters.flow_bar_slots_multiply_lsm = true the table L/s/m is multiplied by the number of parallel slots (catalogue: 'total airflow apportioned between slots').
Throw factors for 1800 mm are not published; the 1200 mm factor (1.0) is carried to the 1.8 m band.

length_correction.source: p.6 Table A (NC, supply) and Table B (throw multiplier)
